ingress.first_output: historical P-1 KV imported; final prompt query really executes on native operator graph
ingress.native_kv_target: same per-rank/layer buffer identities and physical offsets as native lowerer

storage.queue_depth_scope: max across physical owners: outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the admitted request; not NAND page queues

hbf0.memory: outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the admitted request; not NAND page queues
hbf1.memory: outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the admitted request; not NAND page queues

storage.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

dram.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.
dram.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim
